market_context: It is the half-day session after Thanksgiving, with US stocks closing at 1 PM ET. Futures were up 1.6% or more early, but SPY is only +0.48% and is sitting at the bottom of its day range, so the early gains have faded. Macro is hawkish: a December Fed hike is nearly fully priced, October PCE ran hot, the 10-year yield is near 4.9%, and the VIX is about 27. Crypto is weak, with BTC down 2% ahead of roughly $7B in Deribit options expiry.

predictions.reasoning: The post-Thanksgiving half-day is seasonally positive, and the AI and chip dip-buying plus the strong weekly gains support a drift higher. SPY is already near its session low, which limits further downside from here, though the fade from the highs and the hawkish Fed backdrop cap confidence.
Small caps are leading today (+0.97%), and the broad market has held up better than headline tech this week. Thin holiday trading tends to favor drift in the direction of the open.

BTC has failed below the $60-62K resistance zone and is down 2.2% today. Higher-rate expectations, a firming dollar and spot ETF outflows weigh on it, and large options expiry today is skewed toward downside protection.
